name: Noor-ul-Quran
description: Created by Muhammad Younas (Upper Dir). Complete modern Islamic mobile app featuring the Holy Quran with Pashto, Urdu, English translations and audio, dedicated Tafsir page (Urdu, Pashto, English exegesis for all 114 Surahs), Namaz guide, Six Kalmas, Hadith, Sunnah, and Prayer Times.
